subject: general
question: The 12th Hockey India Senior Male National Championship - 2022 was organised by:
solution:
The correct answer is __Madhya Pradesh.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__12th Senior Men’s National Hockey Championship 2022:

__
 
• The tournament was held in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh
 
• It was held from April 6 to 17, 2022.
 
• Haryana has emerged as the champions after defeating Tamil Nadu 3-1 in the shootout after the final ended 1-1 in regulation time.
 
• Haryana has won the trophy for the first time since 2011.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**13th Hockey India Senior Men National Championship 2023:**

 
• The tournament was **held **at** **the Mayor Radhakrishnan Hockey Stadium **in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.**
 
• It was held from November 17 to 28, 2023.
 
• **Punjab has emerged as the champions** after defeating Haryana.
 
• This is **Punjab's fourth championship.**
